newsitem.title: NORWAY: Elkem to expand Icelandic metals plant.
newsitem.headline: Elkem to expand Icelandic metals plant.

text.p: Norwegian metals producer Elkem ASA said on Thursday it had agreed to expand the capacity at Icelandic Alloys' ferrosilicon plant with a third furnace with a capacity of 40,000 tonnes per year.
Partners in Icelandic Alloys are Den Islandske Stat, Sumitomo Corp and Elkem.
The new furnace at Grundartangi will come on stream in 1999, Elkem said in a statement to the Oslo bourse.
The construction of a new furnace will require investment of around 250 million NOK, Elkem said.
It said the investment would partly be funded by Elkem increasing its stake in the venture by 90 million crowns to 51 percent.

"The shareholders have agreed to list Icelandic Alloys on the bourse in Reykjavik. Den Islandske Stat has at the same time decided to sell part of its interest on the Icelandic stock market," the statement said.
